legend.DEGENERATE: present but near-constant or very low coverage -> weak/unsafe
legend.DISTRIBUTION: present but distribution differs materially across datasets

node_model.webqsp: document titled by Freebase entity name

graph.row_space_interface: master_nodes.neighbors gives row-space adjacency for ALL datasets (uniform interface used by l2_relation); canonical graph_*.tsv are in hash/curid id-space and would need a title/curid crosswalk -> avoid by using master_nodes.neighbors

anchor_coverage_val.measure: fraction of val queries (n~=315-400) with an anchor resolving to a graph node

retrieval_seed.note: dense/splade top-k present for every query by construction

S0_retrieval_relative.note: dense/splade scores present for all; percentile-normalized -> corpus-scale-free

query_entity_anchor_bracket.verdict: EXCLUDED FROM CONTRACT — present only for metaqa, so its presence trivially reveals dataset identity

query_anchor_title_match.verdict: NOT a safe STANDALONE anchor — coverage (1.0/0.93/0.67/0.24) is dataset-correlated; use ONLY as a refinement on top of retrieval-seeded anchors

structural_graph_rowspace.note: uniform row-space interface; provenance/typing varies but only untyped adjacency + node embeddings are consumed

seed_distance.note: conditional on anchor; retrieval-seeded -> ~1.0 coverage; ABSTAIN sentinel + flag otherwise

PPR.note: row-space graph + seed restart set; percentile-normalized within query-local scope

directional_geometry_s_dir.DEMONSTRATED_VALUE: metaqa ONLY (Track-A/Q2, entity-anchored); text/webqsp efficacy via retrieval-seed anchors is UNTESTED and is an explicit B1/Track-A-extension question

expansion_provenance.note: P50 membership + geometry hop; expansion_hop DEGENERATE on pure-P50 (no-expansion) scopes

missingness_reveals_identity.bracketed_entity: YES, perfectly (metaqa=1, all others=0) -> EXCLUDED from the contract
missingness_reveals_identity.title_match_alone: YES, partially (squad 0.24, musique 0.67 vs ~1.0 elsewhere) -> NOT used as sole anchor; retrieval-seeded base makes anchor_present ~1.0 uniformly and non-revealing
missingness_reveals_identity.relation_type_count: YES (metaqa 9 / webqsp 6094 / others 1) -> relation TYPE EXCLUDED; only displacement direction (s_dir) used
missingness_reveals_identity.graph_scale_degree_hop_ppr_absolute: YES if used as absolute values (hotpot graph 15M edges vs metaqa 133k) -> neutralized by per-query percentile normalization; contract mandates percentile/bounded features, never raw scale
missingness_reveals_identity.ner_knn_graph_presence: would reveal identity (metaqa/webqsp lack ner; hotpot lacks knn) -> both EXCLUDED from mainline

data_availability_caveats.implication: a LOCAL B1 LODO smoke can run 3-way on {2wiki, musique, squad}; full 6-way LODO needs Modal for metaqa/hotpot/webqsp

Q2_population_caveat: Q2 full results and this audit's anchor coverage refer to the valid-query population of the frozen G1/C6 path (>=1 in-scope gold). Do NOT silently generalize to completely L1-failed queries until that population is separately measured.
conclusion: All S0/S1/S2 features are AVAILABLE across all 6 datasets under a UNIFORM interface IF (a) anchors are retrieval-seeded (not bracket, not title-match-alone), (b) all graph-derived features are per-query percentile-normalized, (c) relation TYPE, bracket indicator, and ner/knn-presence are excluded. Under those rules feature missingness does not reveal dataset identity. Open risk: directional-geometry DISCRIMINATIVE value is demonstrated on metaqa only; squad is the weakest structural/directional regime (title-match 0.24, title-mention graph).
